name: Heart Attack Signs
guidance_text: 🚨 Call emergency services immediately. These symptoms together are a sign of a possible heart attack. Do not drive yourself to the hospital. Chew aspirin if it is available and you are not allergic. Sit upright and stay as calm as possible while waiting for help.
symptoms: Chest Pain, Shortness of Breath, Sweating, Vomiting

name: Severe Breathing Emergency
guidance_text: 🚨 Severe difficulty breathing is a medical emergency. Call emergency services or get to the nearest hospital immediately. If you have been prescribed an inhaler use it now while waiting for help.

name: High Fever with Confusion
guidance_text: 🚨 High fever with confusion or altered awareness is a medical emergency. This needs immediate hospital care. Cool the person down with a damp cloth on the forehead and neck while you arrange emergency transport. Do not leave them alone.

name: Meningitis Signs
guidance_text: 🚨 Stiff neck with high fever and headache can be a sign of meningitis which is life threatening. Go to the nearest hospital immediately. Do not wait to see if symptoms improve on their own.

name: Severe Dehydration
guidance_text: 🚨 Severe dehydration with vomiting and diarrhea is dangerous especially in children and the elderly. Seek emergency care now. If the person is conscious give small sips of oral rehydration solution (ORS) on the way to hospital.

name: Coughing Up Blood
guidance_text: 🚨 Coughing up blood is a serious warning sign that needs immediate hospital attention. Cover your mouth when coughing to avoid spreading any infection. Go to hospital now and do not delay.

name: Chest Pain with Rapid Heart
guidance_text: 🚨 Chest pain with a very fast heartbeat needs emergency care immediately. Stop all activity and sit or lie down. Call for help and get to the nearest hospital as fast as possible. Do not drive yourself.

name: Loss of Balance with Severe Headache
guidance_text: 🚨 Sudden loss of balance combined with a severe headache can be a sign of a serious neurological emergency. Call emergency services or go to hospital immediately. Do not let the person walk alone.

name: Fever with Sweating and Chills
guidance_text: Your symptoms of high fever with chills and sweating are serious and need medical attention today. In Nigeria fever with these symptoms always needs to be tested properly. See a doctor or visit a clinic as soon as possible. Stay hydrated with clean water or ORS and rest completely. Do not self-medicate. If your fever rises above 39°C or you feel confused go to hospital immediately.

name: Fever with Headache and Sweating
guidance_text: High fever with headache and sweating needs medical attention today. These symptoms together need proper testing to find the cause. See a doctor or clinic today. Rest completely and stay well hydrated. Do not assume this is just a common cold.

name: Fever with Stomach Pain and Nausea
guidance_text: High fever combined with stomach pain and nausea needs medical attention within 24 hours. See a doctor today for proper testing. Drink only clean boiled water and eat light easily digestible food. Rest completely.

name: Fever with Cough and Weight Loss
guidance_text: A persistent cough with high fever weight loss and sweating needs urgent medical attention. See a doctor today. When coughing cover your mouth and avoid close contact with others until you have been properly assessed.
symptoms: Cough, High Fever, Weight Loss, Sweating

name: Fever with Breathing Difficulty
guidance_text: High fever with cough and difficulty breathing needs urgent medical treatment. See a doctor today. Rest completely stay warm and drink plenty of fluids. If your breathing gets worse before you reach the doctor go directly to the nearest hospital emergency unit.
symptoms: High Fever, Cough, Shortness of Breath

name: Fever with Rash and Joint Pain
guidance_text: Fever with joint pain headache and a rash needs medical attention today. See a doctor for a blood test. Use only paracetamol for pain and fever — do NOT take aspirin or ibuprofen. Stay very well hydrated with clean water.
symptoms: High Fever, Joint Pain, Headache, Skin Rash

name: High Fever with Chills
guidance_text: High fever on its own should never be ignored in Nigeria. See a doctor or visit a clinic today for proper testing. Any fever could have a serious cause that needs to be identified. Stay hydrated rest and avoid self-medicating. If your temperature goes above 39°C or you feel confused go to hospital immediately.

name: Yellowing with Fatigue
guidance_text: Yellowing of the skin or eyes together with fatigue is a serious sign that your liver may need urgent attention. See a doctor within 24 hours for proper blood tests. Avoid alcohol completely. Eat light low-fat meals and rest. Do not ignore this symptom combination.
symptoms: Yellowing of Skin, Yellowing of Eyes, Fatigue

name: Yellowing of Eyes
guidance_text: Yellowing of the eyes is a sign that needs medical evaluation within 24 hours. This can have several serious causes that all need proper testing. Avoid alcohol completely and eat light meals. See a doctor today.

name: Yellowing of Skin
guidance_text: Yellowing of the skin needs medical evaluation within 24 hours. Do not ignore this even if you feel otherwise okay. Avoid alcohol rest and eat light low-fat meals. See a doctor today for blood tests.

name: Breathing Difficulty with Cough
guidance_text: Difficulty breathing together with a cough and fatigue needs prompt medical attention. If you have a prescribed inhaler use it now and sit upright. If your breathing does not improve within 15 minutes go to the nearest hospital. Do not wait to see if it gets better on its own.

name: Chest Pain with Dizziness
guidance_text: Chest pain combined with dizziness and headache needs medical attention today. Stop all activity sit down and rest. Avoid stress and physical exertion. See a doctor today and do not ignore this combination of symptoms.

name: Urinary Pain with Frequency
guidance_text: Pain or burning when urinating together with frequent urination and bladder discomfort needs medical attention within 24 hours. Drink plenty of clean water. Do not self-medicate with leftover antibiotics. A simple urine test at a clinic will confirm the cause and the right treatment.
symptoms: Burning Urination, Frequent Urination, Bladder Discomfort

name: Burning Urination
guidance_text: Burning or pain when urinating needs medical attention within 24 hours. Drink plenty of clean water. Avoid holding your urine for long periods. See a doctor for a urine test to find the cause and get the right treatment. Do not self-medicate.

name: Severe Shortness of Breath
guidance_text: Difficulty breathing on its own is a symptom that should never be ignored. Sit upright and rest immediately. If you have a prescribed inhaler use it. If breathing does not improve within 15 minutes or gets worse go to the nearest hospital emergency unit immediately.

name: Vomiting with Diarrhea and Nausea
guidance_text: Vomiting with diarrhea and nausea usually improves within 48 hours but needs careful management to prevent dehydration. Rest completely and take small frequent sips of oral rehydration solution (ORS) or clean water. Eat light foods like rice or plain bread when you feel able. See a doctor if symptoms persist beyond 2 days or you cannot keep any fluid down at all.

name: Vomiting with Diarrhea
guidance_text: Vomiting with diarrhea needs careful management to prevent dehydration. Take small frequent sips of ORS or clean water — do not drink large amounts at once. Rest and eat nothing for a few hours then try light plain foods. See a doctor if you cannot keep fluid down or symptoms last more than 2 days.

name: Stomach Pain with Vomiting
guidance_text: Stomach pain combined with vomiting and loss of appetite needs a doctor's review within 2-3 days. Avoid spicy foods alcohol and pain relievers like aspirin or ibuprofen. Eat small frequent light meals. If the pain becomes suddenly very severe or you vomit blood go to hospital immediately.
symptoms: Abdominal Pain, Vomiting, Loss of Appetite

name: Stomach Pain with Indigestion
guidance_text: Stomach pain with indigestion and acidity can be managed with some care. Avoid spicy oily and heavy foods. Eat smaller meals more frequently and do not lie down immediately after eating. Take antacids available at pharmacies for temporary relief. See a doctor within 2-3 days if this keeps happening.

name: Fatigue with Vision and Hunger Changes
guidance_text: Feeling very tired with blurred vision and unusual hunger needs a doctor's review within 2-3 days for proper blood tests. Maintain a balanced diet stay hydrated and avoid sugary drinks in the meantime. Do not ignore this combination as it needs proper investigation.

name: Fatigue with Weight Loss
guidance_text: Unexplained fatigue with weight loss needs medical evaluation within 2-3 days. This combination can have several causes that all need proper testing. Eat nutritious meals rest well and see a doctor soon for a proper assessment.

name: Fever with Rash and Itching
guidance_text: Fever with a rash and itching needs medical review. Stay at home to avoid spreading any possible infection. Do not scratch the rash — apply calamine lotion to relieve the itching. See a doctor if the fever is high or the rash spreads to new areas rapidly.

name: Rash with Itching
guidance_text: A rash with itching is worth getting checked by a doctor within 2-3 days. Keep the affected area clean and dry. Do not scratch as this can lead to infection. Antihistamine or antifungal creams are available at pharmacies for temporary relief while you wait for your appointment.

name: Joint Pain with Swelling
guidance_text: Joint pain with swelling needs a doctor's review within 2-3 days. Rest the affected joint and avoid putting weight or strain on it. Apply a cold compress to reduce swelling. Take paracetamol for pain. If the joint becomes very hot red or you develop fever see a doctor sooner.

name: Headache with Dizziness and Fatigue
guidance_text: Headache with dizziness and fatigue needs a doctor's review within 2-3 days. Rest in a quiet dark room and drink plenty of water. Take paracetamol if needed. Avoid driving or operating machinery until you feel better. See a doctor sooner if the headache is very severe or comes on suddenly.

name: Dizziness with Loss of Balance
guidance_text: Dizziness with loss of balance needs medical evaluation within 2-3 days. Sit or lie down immediately when you feel dizzy to avoid falling. Avoid sudden head movements. Do not drive. See a doctor to find the underlying cause.

name: Mild Fever with Fatigue and Nausea
guidance_text: Mild fever with fatigue and nausea needs monitoring. Rest completely and stay hydrated with clean water or ORS. Take paracetamol for fever if needed. Eat light easily digestible food. See a doctor if your fever rises above 38.5°C lasts more than 2 days or new symptoms develop.

name: Swollen Lymph Nodes with Fever
guidance_text: Swollen lymph nodes with fever need medical evaluation within 2-3 days to find the cause. Rest and drink plenty of fluids. Take paracetamol for fever. See a doctor sooner if the swelling is growing rapidly or you feel very unwell.

name: Swollen Lymph Nodes
guidance_text: Swollen lymph nodes that you can feel under your skin need a doctor's evaluation within 2-3 days. They are often a sign that your body is fighting something. Rest drink plenty of fluids and see a doctor for proper assessment.

name: Chest Pain Alone
guidance_text: Chest pain should always be taken seriously. Rest immediately and avoid any physical exertion. If the pain is mild and goes away with rest monitor it closely and see a doctor within 24 hours. If the pain is severe spreads to your arm or jaw or comes with sweating or difficulty breathing treat it as an emergency and go to hospital immediately.

name: Cough with Phlegm
guidance_text: A cough with phlegm needs a doctor's review within 2-3 days. Rest drink warm fluids and take paracetamol if you also have fever. Steam inhalation can help loosen mucus. See a doctor sooner if you have difficulty breathing the phlegm contains blood or you feel very unwell.

name: Eye Redness with Headache
guidance_text: Red eyes with headache need a doctor's review within 2-3 days. Do not rub your eyes. Avoid contact lenses until you have been assessed. Keep your eyes clean with a clean damp cloth. See a doctor sooner if your vision becomes blurred or the pain is severe.

name: Irregular Blood Sugar with Fatigue
guidance_text: Irregular blood sugar with fatigue and difficulty concentrating needs medical attention within 2-3 days for proper blood tests. Avoid sugary foods and drinks in the meantime. Eat regular balanced meals. See a doctor for proper testing and guidance.
symptoms: Irregular Blood Sugar, Fatigue, Difficulty Concentrating

name: Muscle Weakness with Fatigue
guidance_text: Muscle weakness combined with fatigue needs a doctor's review within 2-3 days. Rest and avoid strenuous activity. Eat nutritious meals and stay hydrated. This combination needs proper investigation to find the cause.

name: Pain Behind Eyes with Headache
guidance_text: Pain behind the eyes with headache needs a doctor's review within 2-3 days. Rest in a quiet dark room away from screens. Take paracetamol for pain. Drink plenty of water. See a doctor sooner if the pain is very severe or your vision is affected.

name: Depression with Irritability
guidance_text: Feeling depressed and irritable are signs that you may need some support. Please talk to someone you trust — a family member a friend or a healthcare worker. You do not have to manage this alone. See a doctor or community health worker within 2-3 days. Your mental health matters just as much as your physical health.

name: High Fever Alone
guidance_text: A high fever on its own should never be ignored. See a doctor or visit a clinic today for proper testing. Fever in Nigeria can have several serious causes including malaria that need to be identified with a proper test. Take paracetamol to manage the fever stay hydrated and rest. Go to hospital immediately if your temperature is above 39°C or you feel confused.

name: Headache with Nausea
guidance_text: A headache with nausea can often be managed at home. Rest in a quiet dark room and drink plenty of water as dehydration is a common cause. Take paracetamol if needed. Avoid screens and bright lights. See a doctor if the headache is very severe comes on suddenly does not improve after 24 hours or keeps coming back.

name: Cold Symptoms
guidance_text: Your symptoms sound like a common cold. Rest at home and drink plenty of warm fluids. You can take paracetamol for any discomfort. Steam inhalation helps with congestion and gargling warm salt water soothes a sore throat. Most colds resolve in 7-10 days. See a doctor if you develop a high fever chest pain or difficulty breathing.
symptoms: Cough, Runny Nose, Sneezing, Sore Throat

name: Sore Throat with Runny Nose
guidance_text: A sore throat with a runny nose is usually a sign of a mild viral infection. Gargle with warm salt water and drink plenty of warm fluids like tea with honey. Rest as much as possible. Take paracetamol if needed for discomfort. See a doctor if you develop a high fever difficulty swallowing or symptoms do not improve within 5 days.

name: Mild Fever with Fatigue
guidance_text: Rest and drink plenty of clean fluids. Take paracetamol for fever if your temperature is above 37.5°C. Eat light nutritious meals. Monitor your temperature regularly. See a doctor if your fever rises above 38.5°C lasts more than 2 days or new symptoms appear. Remember any fever in Nigeria is worth getting checked.

name: Body and Muscle Pain
guidance_text: Rest and take paracetamol for pain relief. Apply a warm compress to the sore area. Gentle stretching can help with muscle pain. Stay well hydrated and avoid strenuous activity. See a doctor if the pain is severe getting steadily worse or does not improve within 3 days.
symptoms: Muscle Pain, Joint Pain, Back Pain

name: Back Pain
guidance_text: Back pain can often be managed at home. Rest but try not to stay completely still for too long as gentle movement helps. Apply a warm compress to the painful area. Take paracetamol for pain. Avoid heavy lifting. See a doctor if the pain is severe spreading down your leg or not improving after 3-5 days.

name: Nasal Congestion with Sneezing
guidance_text: Nasal congestion with sneezing is usually a mild viral infection or allergy. Stay in a well-ventilated environment away from dust and smoke. Steam inhalation helps open congested nasal passages. Drink warm fluids. See a doctor if symptoms persist beyond 7 days or you develop a fever.

name: Mild Digestive Discomfort
guidance_text: Eat light easily digestible meals and avoid spicy oily or heavy food. Drink clean water and stay hydrated. Ginger tea can help settle nausea and stomach discomfort. See a doctor if symptoms persist beyond 2 days or you cannot keep food or water down.

name: Loss of Appetite
guidance_text: Loss of appetite is common with many minor illnesses. Try to eat small frequent meals even if you do not feel hungry. Stay hydrated with clean water and light soups. Rest well. See a doctor if your appetite does not return within 3-4 days or you are also losing weight.

name: General Fatigue
guidance_text: Fatigue on its own is often caused by poor sleep dehydration stress or minor illness. Rest as much as possible aim for 8 hours of sleep and drink plenty of water. Eat balanced meals. See a doctor if your fatigue is severe lasts more than a week or comes with other symptoms like fever or weight loss.

name: Mild Cough
guidance_text: A mild cough on its own can usually be managed at home. Drink warm fluids like tea with honey and lemon. Steam inhalation helps soothe the airways. Avoid cold drinks dusty environments and smoke. See a doctor if the cough lasts more than 2 weeks produces blood or comes with fever and difficulty breathing.

name: Isolated Headache
guidance_text: A headache on its own is often caused by dehydration tension or lack of sleep. Drink a large glass of clean water first as this resolves many headaches. Rest in a quiet dark room and take paracetamol if needed. See a doctor if the headache is very severe comes on suddenly unlike any headache you have had before does not improve with paracetamol or keeps coming back frequently.

name: Skin Rash Alone
guidance_text: A rash on its own without fever needs monitoring. Keep the affected area clean and dry. Avoid scratching as this can lead to infection. Note whether it is spreading or changing. Antihistamine cream available at pharmacies can help with itching. See a doctor within 2-3 days or sooner if the rash spreads rapidly becomes painful or is accompanied by fever.

name: Dizziness Alone
guidance_text: Dizziness on its own can be caused by dehydration low blood sugar or standing up too quickly. Sit or lie down immediately when you feel dizzy to avoid falling. Drink water and if you have not eaten recently have a light snack. See a doctor within 2-3 days if dizziness keeps coming back or is affecting your daily activities.
